name: Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards
summary: Hol'anyee asks you to carry her sketches and notes about Un'Goro Crater's creatures to the druids on Mount Hyjal. She hopes the druids will be interested in studying them.

sections.title: A Copy for Hyjal
sections.body: Hol'anyee has been recording and drawing the creatures of Un'Goro Crater in her sketchbooks. She has made a copy for the druids on Mount Hyjal, who enjoy studying the natural world. The journey is a long one, so she asks you to take the book along if you go there.

faq.q: Who is Hol'anyee sending the book to?
faq.answer: Hol'anyee wants the druids on Mount Hyjal to have her copy of the sketchbook.
It contains Hol'anyee's notes and drawings of creatures living in Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: Why does Hol'anyee want the druids to have it?
faq.answer: Hol'anyee thinks the druids will be interested because they love to study the natural world.

faq.q: Where should I take the book?
faq.answer: Take it to a druid at the summit of Mount Hyjal.

angles.text: As a druid, Hol'anyee hopes you will carry her sketches of Un'Goro Crater's creatures to druids on Mount Hyjal, who study the natural world.
